subject: Social Media
title: Cyberbullying's Reach
description: A fast breakdown of Cyberbullying's Reach for builders.

hook.text: A bully in 1990 tormented you at school. After 3 PM, you were safe. Now the bully follows you home—online.

buildup.text: Cyberbullying is relentless: 24/7, no escape, visible to hundreds. The audience amplifies the cruelty.

discovery.text: Studies show cyberbullying victims are twice as likely to self-harm as victims of traditional bullying.

twist.text: Anonymity emboldens. People say things online they'd never say face-to-face. Screens strip empathy.

climax.text: Platforms add reporting tools. But moderation moves slowly and bullies create new accounts in seconds.

punchline.text: The bully doesn't need to find you. You're always online.

quiz.question: How do cyberbullying victims compare to traditional bullying victims?
options: They're twice as likely to self-harm
